cp-01.factual: CLI branches distinguish JSON reads, authoring writes and later native execution; disposable public read/write examples in .artifacts/route-map-cli/mutations.json.

value.list: List public descriptor IDs. describe route-map returns this complete contract.
value.parameters: Read parameters; --set JSON merges declared parameters. Values are strings.
value.map: map MAP_ID: read graph and event-authored nodes; coordinates are tile centers.
value.node: node MAP_ID EVENT_ID: read the event; --set JSON edits name, note, x or y. Positions use integer tiles.
value.commands: commands MAP_ID EVENT_ID PAGE: read native page commands (PAGE starts at 1); --insert JSON appends one plugin command before the terminator.
value.validate: Validate all marked route maps and declared orthogonal connections; reports map/event context.

cp-02.factual: Dryland_6_RouteMap active() checks map note; nodes() respects pages and RouteHidden; Begin is required before reading current state.

public.value: CLI only edits native data; it never plays events. Close/reopen the editor around external writes. Runtime requires active Dryland_6_RouteMap, a map with <RouteMap>, and Begin. Per-map position/visits/overrides survive native saves and transfers; Begin resets them. Save/menu are blocked during travel. Arrival starts the destination native event page once travel ends. Native Common Event and Script commands use standard MZ interpreter semantics, with ignored script completion value; tags never execute JavaScript. RouteHidden pages do not participate. Crossings are not junctions; diagonal links and more than four neighbours are rejected. There is no automatic routing or camera.

cp-03.factual: route-map.md documents integer IDs, integer tile coordinates, JSON string parameter writes, zero outputs and type restrictions; CLI positive(), node and parameters validation enforce these.

cp-04.factual: NodeSize/StepSize/StepGap use Bitmap screen pixels; point() uses native tile centers; travel.elapsed uses ticker.deltaMS; Duration is milliseconds.

value.NodeSize: 78 pixels, minimum 24; square side and hit target.
value.StepGap: 5 pixels, minimum 1; spacing between connector squares.
value.Ink: #360a0b; CSS color for lines and text.
value.Paper: #ead3ae; CSS color for known node backgrounds.
value.ReducedMotionVariable: 0 means system prefers-reduced-motion; positive native variable ID means nonzero value skips travel. Afogados configures 47.

cp-05.factual: graph(), canMove() and arrive() implement true/false return and first/always; RouteImage overrides active page graphic; UT-079 exercises visits/return.

value.RouteNode: Stable ID unique within a map.
value.RouteLinks: Comma-separated IDs; undirected edges, at most four per node. Orthogonal positions required.
value.RouteReturn: true (default) permits visited nodes; false disallows returning to visited nodes.
value.RouteArrival: first (default) fires once per Begin; always fires at every arrival.
value.RouteImage: PNG picture basename without extension, loaded from img/pictures. Overrides the active native page graphic.
value.RouteHidden: Native page comment excludes this event when that page is active.

cp-18.factual: Compared editor plugin header, runtime handlers, CLI help and guide: same four commands; Query truthiness and output0 semantics explicit. Runtime params and registered defaults reconcile in guide.

value.Begin: Reset attempt, visits and overrides at node; does not fire arrival. Required before other commands.
value.Restore: Set current node without resetting visits or firing arrival.
value.SetNode: Replace node enabled/revealed (true unless false), label and picture image overrides; saves with the attempt. Empty image uses the native page graphic.
value.Query: kind=current writes the current ID to variable; kind=visited writes whether node was visited. switch receives the truthiness of the same value. Output ID 0 disables that output.
